title: AWS Lambda pushes back Node.js 20.x runtime block dates to 2027
summary: AWS delayed enforcement on AWS Lambda's deprecated Node.js 20.x runtime: new-function creation on nodejs20.x is now blocked starting February 1, 2027 and updates to existing nodejs20.x functions are blocked starting March 3, 2027, later than the September 2026 dates widely cited by secondary sources; security patching for the runtime already stopped April 30, 2026.

sources.title: The Node.js 20 Lambda Deadline Everyone Is Citing Is Wrong and the Real Risk Already Started

title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2027 (expected)
summary: Samsung has not yet announced a date, but reporting expects the next Galaxy Unpacked, likely debuting the Galaxy S27 series, in January or February 2027 following the company's usual annual pattern.

title: Claude Opus 4.6 reaches minimum guaranteed support floor
summary: Anthropic's model-deprecations page lists Claude Opus 4.6 with a tentative retirement not sooner than February 5, 2027, one year after its release, matching Anthropic's standard one-year support floor.

title: Azure AI Foundry retires the August 2025 GPT-5 snapshot
summary: Microsoft's Foundry Models lifecycle policy lists a not-sooner-than retirement date of February 5, 2027 for the gpt-5 (2025-08-07) model version in Azure AI Foundry.

title: FTC v. Amazon monopoly trial begins
summary: This February 9, 2027 date for the FTC's monopolization trial against Amazon was itself pushed back by the court to March 29, 2027. Superseded — see "Amazon-FTC antitrust bench trial rescheduled to March 2027."

title: Let's Encrypt default profile switches to 64-day certificates
summary: Let's Encrypt will switch its default 'classic' ACME certificate profile to issuing 64-day certificates with a 10-day authorization reuse period.

title: AAAI 2027
summary: The 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence runs at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal, Canada.

title: OpenAI retires whisper-1 and gpt-4o-transcribe family
summary: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize are scheduled for removal from the OpenAI API on February 26, 2027.

title: OpenAI retires Whisper-1 and GPT-4o transcription models
summary: OpenAI removes whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize from the API, following an August 26, 2026 developer notice; OpenAI recommends migrating to its gpt-transcribe/gpt-live-transcribe models.

title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 14 reaches end of standard support
summary: Amazon RDS ends standard support for PostgreSQL 14 on February 28, 2027; Extended Support billing begins March 1, 2027.

title: Kubernetes 1.35 reaches end of life
summary: Kubernetes 1.35 ("Timbernetes"), released December 17, 2025, enters maintenance mode on December 28, 2026 and reaches end of life on February 28, 2027 under the project's roughly 14-month support policy.
